title: litt.md — launch film
logline: For people building with Claude Code: litt.md turns a person's taste into rules, tokens and components an agent builds with, and checks it against. Open the gallery.

scenes.intent: Name the problem in one breath: agents build in everyone's taste, not yours.

beats.note: l1 rises word by word; four identical generic page thumbnails cascade in below it (grid stagger)
l1 steps back to the grey and the thumbnails dim; 'Not yours.' rises (the scene's moment)
'Not' steps back; only 'yours.' keeps fg; the thumbnails sink out

elements.note: First line of the one statement: a single <Headline> (display) holding l1 and l2 as block spans, left on the safe edge, in the upper half (top ≈ 200). fg, then the grey at b2.
Second line, same Headline. fg; at b3 'Not' dims and 'yours.' keeps fg.
Inline span inside l2, pinned to text-fg. Emphasis by ink.

Four identical 'generic AI page' thumbnails (thumb0…thumb3) in a row across the title-safe width, 16:10, 32px gaps, below the headline: each a flat surface-1 card (rounded-surface, shadow-raised) with shapes only — a centred headline bar, a pill button bar, three equal cards. All neutral (fg at low opacity); no gradients, no text. The same page four times = 'everyone's taste'.

scenes.motion: Solid canvas. b1: l1 maskUp by words (responsive); thumbs rise in a grid cascade 0.1s later (40ms). b2: l1 `dim`, thumbs dim (opacity to ~0.35, instant), l2 maskUp by words on the expressive spring — the one moment. b3: l2 `dim` ('yours.' keeps fg) and the thumbs `dropOut` (0.75×, ease out) so the statement ends alone. Camera 1 → 1.03, origin left edge. Hard cut into the light.
